scope: Public golf facilities in all 50 US states and DC; incomplete, first acquisition batch.
record_unit: One source-listed golf facility. Holes are its published total, so 27/36 may comprise multiple layouts; totals are not invented 27/36-hole rounds.
public_access_basis: Each included source explicitly labels Public. Private and unverified semi-private facilities are excluded.
address_basis: Published course or mailing address; city-only listings remain null. Not a verified driving entrance.
freshness: Observed on updated_on; source publication dates are often unknown. No claim of real-time operating status.
county_basis: County of an exact Census address match, not proof of the entire course footprint. Missing/ambiguous matches remain null.
rights: Independently structured bare facts with citations; no source prose, photographs, maps or scorecard artwork copied. No third-party website license asserted.

state_intake_notes.IA: Public-labelled member facilities plus two Nebraska-association Iowa listings; not all Iowa public courses.
state_intake_notes.NE: 127 Nebraska facilities in association Public filter; unverified Semi-private excluded.
state_intake_notes.ND: Partial intake: 20 of 93 Public-labelled directory entries before collector interruption.

coverage.county_gap_search: Not started. State inventory intake does not establish county completeness, and no result does not establish no public courses.
